tasks.subject: Explore project context for DC API issuance
tasks.description: Map elpaso's existing dcapi/ presentation plumbing, registry sync, issuance flow, and CMWallet's createcred/ + provision matcher reference. Verify registry-provider alpha04 exposes registerCreationOptions.

tasks.subject: Ask clarifying questions on DC API issuance scope
tasks.description: One question at a time. Cover: target interop scenario, grant types in scope (pre-authorized vs authorization_code), matcher toolchain policy (vendor prebuilt wasm vs build from source), UX surface, and whether inline issuer metadata from the DC API request must be honoured.

tasks.subject: Propose 2-3 architecture approaches with trade-offs
tasks.description: Compare reusing the existing OfferConsent/IssuanceClient flow via a synthesized offer URI vs adding a native inline-offer path, and matcher sourcing options. Lead with a recommendation.

tasks.subject: Present sectioned design for approval
tasks.description: Sections scaled to complexity: registration/creation-options, matcher, DC API entry activity, offer handoff into issuance, response envelope, error handling, testing. Get approval after each section.

tasks.subject: Write and commit design spec
tasks.description: Save to docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-21-dc-api-issuance-design.md, run the spec self-review (placeholders, internal consistency, scope, ambiguity), commit.

tasks.subject: User reviews spec, then invoke writing-plans
tasks.description: Ask user to review the committed spec. On approval, invoke the superpowers:writing-plans skill to produce the implementation plan. Do not invoke any other skill.
